body:
The current frozen V42 M1 can evaluate every grid-security constraint directly from master P/Q controls and unique affine grid auxiliaries. This child of PR157 adds exact original-row generation, preserves all route/mode/P/Q/SOC/rho domains, and measures one sequential comparison. Scientific equivalence passes; practical global-gap progress does not, so `NEW_M1_DECOMPOSITION_SELECTED=false` and the final state is `NEW_DECOMPOSITION_REJECTED`.

### Structure and historical evidence

- No-solve audit covers every variable and row family, original CSR coefficients, native +1 affine pivots, senses, bounds, objective and source/input SHA. Primary classification: `DIRECT_EXACT_ROW_GENERATION_POSSIBLE`. Grid-only Benders is unnecessary; the PR115 giant P/Q/SOC recourse is not revived.
- Original current M1: 886,017 rows / 316,743 columns / 208,312 binaries / 8,447,855 nnz. Initial master: 287,552 rows / same columns and binaries / 2,784,047 nnz. Defer 598,465 original security rows; retain all 81,216 sparse affine auxiliaries and definitions. Auxiliary removal is zero.
- Add ALL violated original rows, never top-K. Native insertion preserves exact coefficient/RHS/sense bytes. Exhaustive separation includes original full unreduced duplicate and constant rows; outward roundoff enclosures trigger exact binary-rational fallback at ambiguous boundaries. No critical gamma threshold or approximate grid evaluation is used.
- Preserve V16.3 May02 equivalence and Standard BD29 vs CL-MC-BD7 iterations, while retaining the fact that its monolithic reference was faster. Preserve PR115–120's slow/ill-conditioned giant recourse and PR124's unproven practical binary-reduction benefit. PR157 code/Git blobs remain unchanged; all 100 original worktree evidence hashes pass. Twelve inherited checkout text files differ only by Git newline normalization; original exact bytes are archived separately without modifying inherited files.

### One bounded development comparison

Fresh original monolithic A then exact rowgen B run sequentially with identical original solver settings and the same validated Start and full-domain rational floor. Each arm allocates up to 280s including build, under ONE shared 600s continuous window. Measured worker wall is 554.019087s; the outer supervisor including common input validation is 559.129130s. No concurrent native arm and no resource-based guard/throttling.

| Metric | A monolithic | B rowgen |
|---|---:|---:|
| Valid starting/final UB | 0.6694159238756877 | 0.6694159238756877 |
| Valid starting/final LB | 0.5687115725336208 | 0.5687115725336208 |
| Valid starting/final global gap | 15.043614552672% | 15.043614552672% |
| Global gap reduction/wall-second | 0 | 0 |
| Master solves | 1 | 2 |
| Rows added per iteration | 0 | 213,157; 3,941 |
| Final active rows | 886,017 | 504,650 |
| Native runtime | 273.096s | 272.530s |
| Build-inclusive arm wall | 277.264s | 276.476s |
| Peak process RSS | 3.008GiB | 2.106GiB |
| Peak process commit | 3.675GiB | 2.599GiB |
| New valid integer incumbent | none | none |

The rowgen terminal native objective `0.6548888653197326` is rejected as an original UB: it violates 3,941 original `voltage_upper` rows, max squared-row violation `0.12322020406937549`. All those rows are inserted, but the development budget ends before a third solve. Row generation is NOT converged. Final best-UB exhaustive separation PASS refers to the original validated Start retained on both arms, not this rejected candidate.

Raw native bounds improve from A0.2529539576 to B0.5635117196, but both remain below the already certified original floor0.5687115725. RSS is about30% lower, but both limited solves have one root node and show no new valid global UB/LB or faster B&B progress. Memory reduction alone does not pass the selection gate. The registered `.005` global target is unchanged; P1 is not accepted.

### Validation and final stop

- 12 bounded route/mode/P/Q/SOC/PCS/grid fixtures: all1,536 discrete assignments agree with monolithic feasibility/optima (49 feasible / 1,487 infeasible).
- 52 regression tests pass; cancellation, <=/>=/= signs, zero-nnz rows, original coefficient transport, deliberately omitted violations and failure without final separation are covered.
- Independent closeout performs zero native optimization calls; replays every added original axis and validates both final certified points against full unreduced matrix/grid and original route/SOC/PCS validators. Compile/diff/source/manifest checks pass.
- No 3600s production canary, May M campaign, P2, B2/B3, compact PR124 challenger or subsequent full-scale solve. Development timing is not paper runtime.

Evidence: `docs/v42_m1_exact_grid_rowgen_20261006/FINAL_REVIEW_KO.md`, family partitions, affine proof, exactness fixtures, raw native points, row axes, global-gap/resource ledgers, independent audits and SHA manifest. Benchmark source is frozen at `7bdd5468` and post-experiment work only clarifies/audits saved evidence.
title: V42 M1: exact grid row generation audit and bounded nonselection
